_doc: G5 consecutive-failure auto-rollback ledger. current_streak increments ONLY on new agent-written-code bugs (including job-design bugs such as an IdleBot cancellation of a GPU job with a long CPU-only phase); infrastructure failures (HF timeout, scp race, connection/auth failures, node launch-kills, NODE_FAIL, walltime-kill of code whose checkpoints were advancing, pending time) set counted_in_streak=false and do NOT increment; an OOM follows the triage table in references/autonomy-model.md. At current_streak >= max_streak, set auto_rollback_triggered=true and downgrade all T1 auto-submits to human-approval until a HUMAN resets (the agent must not clear its own rollback). A clean new-code success resets current_streak to 0.
